name: Zhejiang Century Huatong Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Century Huatong Group Co.,Ltd engages in the auto parts, Internet games, and artificial intelligence cloud data businesses in China and internationally. The company is involved in the manufacture, processing, and sale of auto parts, motorcycle parts, and precision metal molds; design, production, and sale of metal stamping parts and injection molded parts; wholesale of plastic particles and metal products; and technical development, consulting, services, and sale of computer software and hardware.
